title: Closures checkpoint
prompt: Implement `static List<Func<int>> Counters(int n)` returning n functions; function i returns i-th value 0,1,...,n-1 — each counter must return ITS OWN index (proving you captured per-iteration values correctly, not one shared variable). Then implement `static Func<int,int> Adder(int start)` returning a function that adds its argument to `start` and returns the RUNNING total (state must persist across calls — a captured mutable local).

tests.name: per-iteration-capture
tests.hint: Capture a per-iteration copy (or the foreach/loop variable under C# 5+ semantics).

tests.name: persistent-state
tests.hint: A captured local mutates across invocations — that is the closure's display class field.
